topic: GitHub access issue for interview candidate
summary_markdown: The conversation addressed an issue where a link to GitHub, provided by [me] to someone (Nina), resulted in a 404 error. It was suspected that the necessary repository access might not have been granted within the team's settings. The participants agreed on the need to grant full code access.
decisions: Full code access needs to be granted for the GitHub link.
action_items: Someone needs to ensure proper repository access is added/granted.
